limitations: VERIFIED means the cited work exists and matches the identified record, not that each metadata field or whole source text was independently retrieved.
No retraction census is claimed; a positive correction record is reported where found.
External fresh abstract availability does not fill a missing locked support excerpt or digest.
Source author names do not authenticate the manuscript author or establish personal reading.
All earlier failed/wrong investigator requests remain in the raw record; no failed request is treated as evidence against a reference.
